name: Grant Program
summary: Quarterly equipment and travel grants supporting wildlife research, habitat monitoring and conservation. The programme includes product grants, software-only grants and travel grants for early-career professionals.

amount.note: Product grants are up to USD 12,000 in products per quarter; individual applicants are capped at USD 4,000 and travel grants at USD 1,000.

status.quote: Wildlife Acoustics offers a quarterly grant program supporting wildlife research, habitat monitoring, and conservation.

applicant_types.quote: Standard Product Grant: up to $12,000 USD in products per quarter; individual applicants up to $4,000 USD.

access.quote: How to Apply: English; one letter of recommendation (not for Software-Only); tax-exempt certificate; complete applications only; no shipping to Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Crimea.
